grounding.states: Mark Carney is the prime minister of Canada
grounding.from: Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada.

grounding.states: He took office in March 2025 (14 March 2025)

grounding.from: He succeeded Justin Trudeau as prime minister and as Liberal leader.

value.answer: Mark Carney. He's been PM since March 2025, taking over from Justin Trudeau. Still in the job as of this week, going by the official government site.
